items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Does Charny sing on, Papa's Got the Jim Jams? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Well Ferdinand sang on one, yeah. And then there was another fella, Charlie, somebody who sang on another.

ctx.x: Does Charny sing on, Papa's Got the Jim Jams? I think he's supposed to sing on one of them, yeah. And then Frog's brother, what's his name, Ferdinand Joseph?
Well Ferdinand sang on one, yeah. And then there was another fella, Charlie, somebody who sang on another.
